candidate_cold_recovery.timing_limit: Initial attempt and recovery are separate measured runs, not one successful cold wall time.

continuation: Finish seed/scrub, realistic minus/add/post, focused tests and local checkpoint. No push/promotion.

derived_store_comparison.measurement_scope: Derived directory payload bytes at completed full-corpus R2 boundary; manifests and receipts included. Baseline recorded before verified pruning.

legacy.expected_saving: Bounded by measured legacy discovery-other time; exact function timer recorded in subsequent runs.
legacy.finding: Full SHA of every legacy summary source on every discovery, even summary hits.
legacy.parity_risk: Summary inventory includes excluded artifacts. Bind header/count/classification inputs and verifier version; preserve all existing temporal qualification.
legacy.proposal: Reuse the five-field source fingerprint, verifier-qualified raw-SHA receipt and indexed file anchor; full SHA on any missing/mismatched receipt.

t0.finding: Original-T0 reuse re-streams records and then full-hashes the same T0 after header receipt verification.
t0.parity_risk: Must bind every origination and competing-seal input; invalidating only raw T0 is insufficient. No change to PIT, source authority or admission.
t0.proposal: Introduce an explicit verifier-qualified origination proof keyed by original seal/index/write receipt, operation pair, capture binding and source fingerprint; retain full existing checks on miss.

measured_growth_projection.interpretation: Offline worst-case all-invalidated model, not a measured historical Daily crossing. No causal size curve can be fitted from a single corpus size.
measured_growth_projection.limitations: Projection holds per-session mix, hardware and non-evaluate cost fixed; terminal maturity and growing discovery can change the slope. Use realistic add profile separately.

design_input_not_remeasured.note: Quoted from the published M1 round-2 rehearsal. This phase did not remeasure it.

all_partitions_invalidated.note: 2026-05-08 at 2.061 s is a one-off fixture spike, not a corpus rate. stream_sha256_bytes stayed 0 because T0 fingerprint receipts hit.

cold.settled_misses: not recorded on the cold print

fixture_profile.corpus: 22 modern T0 sessions, then one appended session. Four tickers. No legacy artifact, so price files stay off the PriceIndex path.

one_new_session.note: rows_output_changed counts rows whose canonical bytes differ from the prior partition. The appended session matures earlier horizons. The artifact still matches the in-memory builder.

fixture_store_bytes.note: 23 tiny sessions. Not a measurement of the 1.75 GB M1 store and not a plus-25 percent proof.

growth_projection.reason: The fixture is 23 sessions and 92 rows. Seconds per session on that corpus do not predict the 60,588-row stage. Phase 2 must measure the real corpus and fit the 1,200 s crossing. The mid-December 1,130 s model is not confirmed.

levers.L1_minimal_projection: TAKEN. Sidecar contract prospective_feedback_evaluator_input/v3. Fixture JSON-decode was 0.0037 s of 1.831 s evaluate (0.2 percent). This does not close the 508 s evaluate.
levers.L2_row_reuse: TAKEN. On the 23-session fixture, forcing every partition manifest to miss reused 1 row and re-evaluated 91. Rows inside the 20-session horizon are not final. A streaming edit changes source_key, so M1 partition bytes are not visible to this code.
levers.L3_price_fingerprint: TAKEN. Covered by tests/test_tplus_m1b_incremental.py::test_price_fingerprint_hit_does_not_hash. The all-modern fixture never calls PriceIndex, so price_index_s is 0 here.
levers.L4_verifier_unit: TAKEN. Digest covers source_file_fingerprint.py and source_verifier.py only. This deploy still needs one seed because that unit is new.
levers.L5_spool_write: NOT_TAKEN. Published aggregate plus assemble is 29.522 s of 748.745 s (3.9 percent), under the 15 percent bar.

targets.warm_discovery_block: The published 186-206 s is discover_prospective_corpus and discover_snapshots, in modules this phase must not edit. Price fingerprinting removes the price-file SHA from price_index_s (published 2.5 s), not that discovery time.

tests.failure_reason: ROADMAP_MULTIPLE_SOURCE_WRITERS. Active milestone TPLUS_INCREMENTAL_COST_V2 is matched by wt-tplus-incremental-v2-20261104 on fix/tplus-incremental-cost-v2 and by this required branch. The checker and the other worktree are outside the allowed edit set.
